text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—I'm planning to give chocolates like this 
next week! To express my everyday 
gratitude. ...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful! I'm sure the SPs will be 
thrilled...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh! On Valentine's Day... love bestowed 
by my liege...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Truly, a knight's fondest desire!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was participating in a social 
gathering. As for why...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Here is your participant certificate. 
Thank you very much for coming.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Still—Durandal-san, to think you'd also 
show interest in our Expedition Support 
Committee's event... It is a pleasant 
surprise.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I felt that there was a kind of discipline 
that could only be forged here.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well now. I'm sure it will live up to your 
expectations. Many people from the racing 
world are attending, after all...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I've prepared food like pizza and pasta to 
keep the conversation flowing. And on top 
of that—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: You mean *that* game, right?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"It's a game to test your intellect. You 
compete in and learn about race trivia 
from home and abroad."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
How about trying it to test your skills? 
Your interest in expeditions... and 
consequently, in our committee, is sure to 
deepen.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"It is intellect that makes a knight among 
knights! I shall solve it with ease, my 
liege."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see. The grid written on the back of the 
participation pass... This was actually a 
word puzzle, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, whoever solves the word puzzle 
the fastest gets some training gear. 
...That said, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The problem posted on the wall asked 
about the equipment needed for the trip... 
However, if solved straightforwardly, the 
character count would overflow."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ! Could it be written in Italian?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
They said the venue's food sounded like 
some fancy foreign special move—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I-In other words... It's just that it's 
always Italian food, and it's been on my 
mind for a while.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A reward from my sister. You should take 
pride in it.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"There was surprisingly a lot I didn't 
know about racing abroad... It's been a 
very fruitful discussion. I'll be sure to 
consult you again if anything comes up."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Likewise. The way you handled it with your 
intellect and brilliant presence of 
mind... It was quite instructive.
choice_data_list: That was some incredible quick thinking.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ! As a knight, it's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, I made a great impression! Next 
up is—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. While I was resting in my 
room... I received a message from Durandal 
asking, "If you have some time."

text_block_list.name: Curren & Durendal
text_block_list.text:
Surprise Collab Stream! "Princess & 
Knight! Test of Courage Mountain 
Climb~â"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Today, guess what! Durandal-san came up 
with her very own project to show off her 
courage~!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It takes courage to climb this mountain, 
but... apparently, you get to see a truly 
amazing starry sky in return.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So dreamy~♡ Sir Durnad... no! Lord 
Durandal, please protect Princess Curren 
all the way to the top♡

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Only with courage is one a true knight 
among knights. No matter the hardship, I 
will blaze a path through!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Durandal-sama, you're amazing~♡ You 
breezed right past that scary cliff and 
the suspension bridge!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, didn't I tell you? Only with 
'courage' can one truly be a knight among 
knights.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now, once we get through this forest, the 
summit is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whwoooosh......)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Eep! ...Was that just the wind? I didn't 
know the forest at night could be this 
scary...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-When they said it takes courage... did 
they mean dealing with horror stuff too?! 
...B-But... that's all the more reason—!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, I'm fine! No matter what we face, 
I will protect you.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even if my opponent is a bear... Or-Or a 
ghost... I will—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Whwooooosh~~~...... *murmur* 
*murmur*......)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Nngh!! I am the knight among knights!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Princess! Get on my back!! I shall carve a 
path forward with these legs...!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Deyaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for yesterday! You looked so 
cool carrying me on your back as you ran 
through that dark forest♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Durandal-san... you possess incredible 
"courage", don't you? ♡
choice_data_list:
Yeah! I thought to myself, that's a true 
knight for you!

Yeah! I thought, "That's a true knight for 
you."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ! I-I am truly blessed!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Alright... yes!! I successfully showed 
off my 'intellect' and 'courage'!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(...Tomorrow is finally Valentine's Day. 
Speaking of the ultimate proof of 
knighthood to show—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. Called out by Durandal, I 
arrived at the meeting spot to find...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Are you the knight and the king who 
summoned me?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then you'll show me, won't you? Show this 
witch your "power".

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Prove that you are worthy of the 
'Strength' blessing magic!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"It is through 'strength' that one becomes 
the knight among knights!!! Watch closely, 
my Lord!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Y-You want me to move this rock...?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I'm letting you use magic, 
so you'd better show me some power worthy 
of it.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
!! ...No. Only with "strength" can one 
truly be a knight among knights!!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oregano Recovery! ...Here, a blessing for 
your "strength"!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... Thank you very much.
choice_data_list:
That was really amazing! I can't believe 
you actually moved that thing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's right♪ For a knight of your 
caliber, I wouldn't mind working my magic 
again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After coming down the mountain, I walked 
through town with Durandal. Just as I was 
thinking how eventful the past few days 
had been—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Take my hand, if you'd like. I'll walk 
you back to the dorm.
choice_data_list: It's not that dark, so it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...There's an awkwardness in her gait. 
Fatigue from coming down the mountain must 
have reached her legs."
choice_data_list: Amazing, how did you figure that out...?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Something of this level is only 
natural—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ouch!?

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine after a night's rest, 
but... you've put a tremendous strain on 
your muscles these past few days, haven't 
you? Make sure you get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I am truly sorry. To neglect the 
vital care of a knight's sword, of all 
things...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Durandal was feeling unexpectedly down. 
Hoping it would bring some comfort, I 
handed over what I had prepared since 
morning.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ! Chocolate...!
choice_data_list: If there's anything else you need...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghh! No, not at all! Could anything 
ever surpass this!?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I will cherish it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing Durandal's smile made this a truly 
heartwarming Valentine's Day for me, too."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...There's an awkwardness in her gait. 
Fatigue from coming down the mountain must 
have reached her legs."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Bullseye. Struck by your spot-on 
remark, I opened my mouth to praise you, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of all the times, I had to sneeze right at 
that very moment...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle... slide slide)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. Hopefully, this will warm you 
up a bit.
choice_data_list:
No, no!? Without your jacket, you're gonna 
freeze too...!

No, no!? Without your jacket, you're gonna 
freeze too...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, I'm an active racehorse Umamusume, 
you know? My conditioning is on another 
level.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having it put that way left me completely 
at a loss for words.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we be on our way?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is truly someone you can count on. She 
has "knowledge," "courage," and 
"strength"... as well as "kindness."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her performances over the past 
few days made me feel that all the more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I truly feel that even an 
inexperienced person like myself has 
managed to make it this far.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling grateful, I bundled up tighter in 
my coat. Just then... I felt a small 'tap' 
against my fingertips.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With everything that happened today, it 
completely slipped my mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take the box from my jacket's inner 
pocket and hold it out to Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, th-this is...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: CHOCOLATE!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
At last... the chocolate... the love from 
the King! The honor of one who has 
mastered chivalry... is in my hands...!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ngggh!! Ahhh, do you know how much I—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Did I... want it, after all...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I... lost my composure... To lose my cool 
like this in public...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
To think that I could be worthy of 
receiving such an honor... It's... far too 
much...
choice_data_list: Because she was just that happy, right?

Because she was just that happy, wasn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes! It is truly beyond words.
choice_data_list: I'm happy too. Thank you, Durendal.
I'm happy too. Thank you, Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Those are my words.
